rows.en: As a result, the Axis forces led by Haman
were recognized as the rightful heirs of Zeon,
and the hearts of the remaining soldiers
were brought together as one.
Seizing this chance, the Axis forces
steadily began their advance
and gradually drained the Titans
of their strength.
The tide of battle kept shifting.
wiped out the Titans' main fleet,
rows.note: Follows shared row S02457 (AEUG colony laser cannon) as subject.

rows.en: and at that point
Haman decided to pull her forces back.
Leaving behind the Titans, who had lost
their cohesion and were bound to disband,
and the AEUG, stripped of all its key pilots
and left all but powerless,
the Axis forces, their strength preserved,
launched a full-scale invasion of the Earth Sphere.
Haman's scheme
had worked perfectly.
was forced to spend some time
rows.note: Continues shared row S02453 (mp_pr_0f05 line 16: Kamuna Tachibana, gravely wounded in battle,) from mission_intro_09.

rows.en: recuperating, but
his achievements in battle so far had been great,
and for the sake of Zeon's coming revival,
he rested and recovered under special treatment.
Haman's forces had defeated the Glemy Faction, but
in the final battle at Core 3 that followed,
their leader, Haman Karn,
was defeated in a duel with Judau Ashta,
and Axis collapsed with the loss of its leader.
With this, the struggle over Zeon
seemed to have come to a complete end, but
in Kamuna's mind,
the memory of one who had vanished a year earlier
kept resurfacing...
That meant that before long
there would be another battle.
Suddenly, as if guided by a mysterious light,
Axis veered off its falling trajectory.
It was Amuro Ray and
Char Aznable's spirits, resonating
with the Psycho-Frame, that caused
this miracle.
Sensing the end of all the fighting, Kamuna
made this battle his last and retired as a pilot.
To a new generation,
humanity's hope would be passed on...
The light that enveloped Axis
may have been a symbol of
rows.note: Row content swapped with S02517 for English word order (JP: such wishes of the people / was a symbol of).

rows.en: that very wish of the people.
Universal Century 0123.
After about a year of scheming in the shadows,
the Crossbone Vanguard came into the open and
declared war on the Earth Federation Government.
Having been out of full-scale war
for a full 30 years, the Federation Forces
fought back mainly with outdated mobile suits, but
the colonies of Frontier Side
fell one after another.
The Crossbone Vanguard belonged to
Cosmo Babylonia, whose ideals
won over quite a few ordinary citizens.
It was just like the Principality of Zeon's
war of independence all over again.
Aiming to achieve what Zeon never could,
the overthrow of the Earth Federation,
and welcoming new queen candidate Berah Ronah,
the morale of the Crossbone forces
rose ever higher.
Having all but completed the Frontier Side campaign,
the main force of the Crossbone Vanguard
rows.note: Rows S02538/39 swap content for English subject-verb order (JP: triumphantly returned / CV main force).

rows.en: made a proud, triumphant return.

rows.en: behind the scenes of that battle,
the soldiers knew nothing.
Iron Mask, their Supreme Commander, had fallen,
and the queen candidate Berah Ronah
had broken away from Cosmo Babylonia.
